properties.areaDesc: Brown, TX; Callahan, TX; Coleman, TX; Concho, TX; Runnels, TX
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 9:50PM CDT until October 15 at 11:45PM CDT by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Brown County in west central Texas...
Southeastern Callahan County in west central Texas...
Coleman County in west central Texas...
Northeastern Concho County in west central Texas...
Southeastern Runnels County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1145 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 949 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1.5 and 2.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding. The heaviest rain fell earlier this evening, resulting
in 1 to 3 inches of rainfall, An additional, 0.25 to 0.50 inches
of rainfall may result in minor flooding across.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Brownwood, Coleman, Ballinger, Early, Santa Anna, Bangs, Cross
Plains, Valera, Silver Valley, Voss, Gouldbusk, Grosvenor, Glen
Cove, Burkett, Lake Brownwood Near Thrifty, Lake Brownwood,
Talpa, Cross Cut, Leaday and Byrds.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.headline: Gale Warning issued October 15 at 9:48PM CDT until October 17 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, west winds to 30 kt with
a few gale force gusts to 35 kt expected. For the Gale
Warning, northerly gales to 40 kt and significant waves to 16
ft occasionally to 21 ft expected.

* WHERE...Calumet Harbor IL to Michigan City IN.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 1 PM CDT Friday.
For the Gale Warning, from 1 PM Friday to 1 AM CDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 10:40PM EDT until October 16 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...In Indiana, Northern La Porte and Southern La Porte
Counties. In Michigan, Northern Berrien and Southern Berrien
Counties.

* WHEN...From 2 PM EDT /1 PM CDT/ to 11 PM EDT /10 PM CDT/ Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
